books.title: Poorvi: Textbook of English for Grade 6
books.edition: Reprint 2026-27 (First Edition June 2024; reprinted March 2025 and January 2026)

source.method: chapter titles from the book's Contents page; topics from each chapter PDF's section headings

topics.title: Reading the Story: Part I
objectives: Student can read Part I and explain what Rama Natha believed about a magic potion
Student can explain the task the sage Mahipati gave Rama Natha and predict whether he will complete it
visualIdeas: Rama Natha collecting dew from banana leaves in winter

topics.title: Reading the Story: Part II
objectives: Student can explain how Rama Natha and Madhumati created wealth through hard work
Student can explain the lesson behind the sage's trick
visualIdeas: a timeline from empty fields to a banana plantation and a box of gold coins

topics.title: Thinking about the Story
objectives: Student can answer questions on extracts from the story with reasons
Student can connect causes in the story with their outcomes
visualIdeas: a cause-and-outcome table for events in the story

topics.title: Words and Grammar: Homophones and Connecting Words
objectives: Student can use words from the story correctly to complete a paragraph
Student can identify homophones and use a pair of them in one sentence
Student can join phrases with connecting words to make meaningful sentences
Student can read a tongue twister with the letter b aloud with increasing speed
visualIdeas: homophone pairs drawn as matching cards
two phrases joined by a connecting word

topics.title: Listening and Speaking
objectives: Student can listen to an account of what Madhumati does with her bananas and number the events in order
Student can say words where the letter s sounds /s/ or /z/ correctly
Student can share three ideas for someone who needs to work hard, using sequence phrases
visualIdeas: words sorted into /s/ and /z/ sound bins

topics.title: Writing: Describing a Banana
objectives: Student can describe a banana using details of taste, smell, colour and feel
Student can develop a short script with dialogues from the story and enact it
visualIdeas: a word web around a banana with sense words

topics.title: Reading the Poem
objectives: Student can read the poem aloud and retell how the fox tricked the raven

visualIdeas: the raven on a branch with a morsel and the fox looking up

topics.title: Thinking about the Poem
objectives: Student can answer questions on lines from the poem
Student can explain the fox's intentions and the raven's mistake
visualIdeas: a speech-bubble comic of the fox's sweet words and the raven's reaction

topics.title: Words and Grammar: Rhyme, Alliteration and Opposites
objectives: Student can find rhyming words in each stanza

visualIdeas: rhyming word pairs from each stanza linked by lines

topics.title: Listening and Speaking
objectives: Student can listen to what the crow did after losing his food and mark statements true or false

topics.title: Reading the Story
objectives: Student can read the picture story and identify its characters

topics.title: Thinking about the Story
